scripts.dev: cp index.source.html index.html 2>/dev/null || true; tsx server.ts
scripts.build: cp index.source.html index.html && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && cp dist/server.cjs dist/server.js && mkdir -p dist/tmp && touch dist/tmp/restart.txt && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/version.json', JSON.stringify({commitSha: process.env.GITHUB_SHA || 'local-build', buildTime: process.env.BUILD_TIME || new Date().toISOString()}, null, 2))" && cp dist/index.html ./index.html 2>/dev/null || true
